title: Erase the Injected Region: Multimodal Prompt-Injection Defense with On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2610.41307v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal indirect prompt injection embeds malicious instructions in external media that also contains information needed for the user's task. Existing defenses can block the attack yet impair the model's use of that information, leaving a gap between attack defense and task preservation. We propose ERASE, an on-policy self-distillation method that constructs its reference by erasing the injected region in place. Modality-appropriate blank content replaces the injection while the surrounding media is preserved. A student reading attacked media learns from a frozen base model reading the erased view through full-distribution token-level feedback on its own rollouts. Across image, audio, and video on two model sizes, ERASE records near-zero observed attack success on the evaluated benchmark while retaining task utility close to the undefended clean-input level. On 3B audio, ERASE reaches 60.1% attacked-input accuracy compared with ARGUS

translated_title: 抹除注入区域：基于策略内自蒸馏的多模态提示注入防御
translated_abstract: 多模态间接提示注入将恶意指令嵌入到同时包含用户任务所需信息的外部媒体中。现有防御方法虽然能够阻止攻击，却会损害模型对这些信息的利用，导致攻击防御与任务保留之间存在鸿沟。我们提出了ERASE，一种策略内自蒸馏方法，该方法通过就地抹除注入区域来构建参考视图。使用与模态相适应的空白内容替换注入部分，同时保留周围的媒体内容。读取受攻击媒体的学生模型，通过在自身推演上的全分布词元级反馈，向读取已抹除视图的冻结基础模型学习。在两个模型规模的图像、音频和视频实验中，ERASE在评估基准上实现了接近于零的观测攻击成功率，同时任务效用保持在接近无防御干净输入的水平。在3B音频模型上，ERASE在受攻击输入下达到60.1%的准确率，相比之下ARGUS为……
tldr: 提出ERASE方法，通过就地抹除注入区域构建参考视图并进行策略内自蒸馏，使模型既能防御多模态提示注入攻击，又能保留任务所需的合法信息，实现安全性与实用性兼得。
